path_stats.series_location: source_run (the per-trade rows, in order, with net_r)
path_stats.ordering: by entry_time ascending; pooled ACROSS folds, so this is the full-window path, not a per-fold one
path_stats.not_a_verdict: Descriptive only. No bar is applied here -- the prop bar is B6's to register, and it must be registered before these numbers are read.

decision_rule.rule: Stage 0 requires net_r_oos -- pooled net_total_r from the harness's out-of-sample time-folds, net of the FULL cost stack (fee + slippage + funding) -- to be > 0. Restates the existing promotion-ladder Stage-0 bar as a checkable predicate over this record's own fields; does not itself authorize or perform any roster change.

research_grading.rule_summary: PASS iff measured AND n>=88 AND net_r_oos>0 AND expectancy_r_oos>0 AND 2*folds_positive>folds; n<88 at 365d is UNDERPOWERED and the pre-registered 730d/4-fold re-run decides the powered verdict.
research_grading.note: decision_rule above is the producer's generic D1 predicate (net_r_oos > 0) on the 365d run only. This block is the research unit's registered grading; check_roster_promotion_evidence C4 refuses the record when powered_verdict != pass. Added 2026-10-04 by lane PROP-EVIDENCE.
